name: Discrimination
overview: Scripture clearly condemns discrimination by emphasizing that God shows no partiality or respect of persons, as stated in Acts 10:34 and Romans 2:11. Believers are called to love their neighbors as themselves and to treat others as they would want to be treated, reflecting the commands in Mark 12:31 and Matthew 7:12. Furthermore, Christians are instructed to love even their enemies and pray for those who persecute them, demonstrating a heart opposed to prejudice and discrimination, as taught in Matthew 5:44. The Lord's hatred of injustice and partiality is underscored in Proverbs 6:16, affirming that discrimination contradicts God's righteous standards.
